Flowering plants are plants that bear flowers and fruits , and form the clade Angiospermae ( / ˌ æ n dʒ i ə ˈ s p ɜːr m iː / ). [ 5 ] [ 6 ] The term angiosperm is derived from the Greek words ἀγγεῖον ( angeion ; 'container, vessel') and σπέρμα ( sperma ; 'seed'), meaning that the seeds are enclosed within a fruit. The group was formerly called Magnoliophyta . [ 7 ]
